answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 10852 Country: India Title: I am following hanafi madhab. please inform me whether it is permitted to eat prawn,shrimp & lobstar in hanafi madhab. Question: I am following hanafi madhab. please inform me whether it is permitted to eat prawn,shrimp & lobstar in hanafi madhab. Answer ID: 10852 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 256/232=D/1430) It is makrooh tahreemi (undesirable to an extent of being haram ) to eat prawns. However, some people regard it a kind of fish and allow eating it. For details see: Fiqhi Maqalat by Mufti Muhammad Taqi Usmani. In short, it is better to avoid; it is more precautious. It is allowable if someone eats it considering it lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
